--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem sZMod_eq_s (p' : ℕ) (i : ℕ) : sZMod (p' + 2) i = (s i : ZMod (2 ^ (p' + 2) - 1)) := by
  induction' i with i ih
  · dsimp [s, sZMod]
    norm_num
  · push_cast [s, sZMod, ih]; rfl
-- These next two don't make good `norm_cast` lemmas.

--src: Mathlib.Data.List.NodupEquivFin
theorem get_strictMono (h : l.Sorted (· < ·)) : StrictMono l.get := fun _ _ => h.rel_get_of_lt

--src: Mathlib.Combinatorics.Colex
lemma geomSum_ofColex_strictMono (hn : 2 ≤ n) : StrictMono fun s ↦ ∑ k ∈ ofColex s, n ^ k := by
  rintro ⟨s⟩ ⟨t⟩ hst
  rw [toColex_lt_toColex_iff_exists_forall_lt] at hst
  obtain ⟨a, hat, has, ha⟩ := hst
  rw [← sum_sdiff_lt_sum_sdiff]
  exact (Nat.geomSum_lt hn <| by simpa).trans_le <| single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ by positivity) <|
    mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hat, has⟩

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
lemma testTrueHelper (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.blt 1 p = true) (h : sModNatTR (2 ^ p - 1) (p - 2) = 0) :
    LucasLehmerTest p := by
  rw [Nat.blt_eq] at hp
  rw [LucasLehmerTest, LucasLehmer.residue_eq_zero_iff_sMod_eq_zero p hp, ← sModNat_eq_sMod p _ hp,
    ← sModNatTR_eq_sModNat, h]
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
theorem order_ineq (p' : ℕ) (h : lucasLehmerResidue (p' + 2) = 0) :
    2 ^ (p' + 2) < (q (p' + 2) : ℕ) ^ 2 :=
  calc
    2 ^ (p' + 2) = orderOf (ωUnit (p' + 2)) := (order_ω p' h).symm
    _ ≤ Fintype.card (X (q (p' + 2)))ˣ := orderOf_le_card_univ
    _ < (q (p' + 2) : ℕ) ^ 2 := card_units_lt (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt (two_lt_q _))

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Ordinal.NaturalOps
instance : AddLeftStrictMono NatOrdinal.{u} :=
  ⟨fun a _ _ h => nadd_lt_nadd_left h a⟩

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq
theorem odd_of_mod_four_eq_one {n : ℕ} : n % 4 = 1 → n % 2 = 1 := by
  simpa [ModEq] using @ModEq.of_mul_left 2 n 1 2

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.Fermat
lemma two_lt_fermatNumber (n : ℕ) : 2 < fermatNumber n := three_le_fermatNumber _

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Totient
theorem totient_even {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 < n) : Even n.totient := by
  haveI : Fact (1 < n) := ⟨one_lt_two.trans hn⟩
  haveI : NeZero n := NeZero.of_gt hn
  suffices 2 = orderOf (-1 : (ZMod n)ˣ) by
    rw [← ZMod.card_units_eq_totient, even_iff_two_dvd, this]
    exact orderOf_dvd_card
  rw [← orderOf_units, Units.coe_neg_one, orderOf_neg_one, ringChar.eq (ZMod n) n, if_neg hn.ne']

--src: Mathlib.Computability.Ackermann
theorem ack_add_one_sq_lt_ack_add_four (m n : ℕ) : ack m ((n + 1) ^ 2) < ack (m + 4) n :=
  calc
    ack m ((n + 1) ^ 2) < ack m ((ack m n + 1) ^ 2) :=
      ack_strictMono_right m <| Nat.pow_lt_pow_left (succ_lt_succ <| lt_ack_right m n) two_ne_zero
    _ ≤ ack m (ack (m + 3) n) := ack_mono_right m <| ack_add_one_sq_lt_ack_add_three m n
    _ ≤ ack (m + 2) (ack (m + 3) n) := ack_mono_left _ <| by omega
    _ = ack (m + 3) (n + 1) := (ack_succ_succ _ n).symm
    _ ≤ ack (m + 4) n := ack_succ_right_le_ack_succ_left _ n
